criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a fixture test in hestia.rs covers all four branches: a cause in a disabled stage is skipped as dormant, an existing open request is re-queued via the shared builder and the old one is closed with a reason, an uncovered cause gets a new request citing introspection ids, and the top five by occurrences and recency are urgent while the rest are normal.
criteria.evidence: I ran it and it passed. The test `the_backfill_skips_dormant_requeues_an_existing_request_queues_the_rest_and_ranks_the_top_five_urgent` builds a non-empty backlog: 7 live causes, 1 cause about the planner, 1 cause whose request has landed, and an existing steward request with no acceptance. It asserts the planner cause is skipped with the reason "dormant: the planner stage is disabled in athena.toml" and that nothing cites it. It asserts the existing request is re-queued: the old one is Closed(Dropped) with the reason "re-queued as <new>", and the new text starts with "Priority: urgent", has 3 acceptance items and cites all six introspection ids. It asserts the 6 other live causes get new "Fix the root cause of a repeated failure" requests citing their ids. It asserts the ranking order, including the recency tie-break, and that ranks 0–4 are urgent and ranks 5–6 normal.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a second backfill run over the same fixtures queues, re-queues and closes nothing.
criteria.evidence: `a_second_backfill_over_the_same_records_queues_requeues_and_closes_nothing` passed. It asserts the first run queued 6. On the second run it asserts changed_nothing(), Queued=0, Requeued=0, HEAD unchanged (no commit, so nothing was closed), the same request-job count, and 7 lines reading "already covers the cause".

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: status output lists each repeated cause with its request after the backfill and lists dormant causes in a separate section.
criteria.evidence: `status_shows_each_repeated_causes_request_after_the_backfill_and_dormant_causes_apart` passed. Before the backfill there are 7 repeated causes with no request and 1 dormant cause. After it, all 7 have a queued request, the dormant list is still separate, and no "no root-cause request" next-line is left. The display test `dormant_causes_are_listed_apart_with_their_stage` also passed: the text status prints a separate "dormant" section, and the existing repeated section prints "request <job> (<state>)".

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo run -- hestia review --backfill` help or a CLI test: the flag is accepted and prints what was queued, re-queued and skipped, with the reason for each.
criteria.evidence: The help shows `athena hestia review [OPTIONS] --backfill` with a description. The CLI parse test passed: `--backfill` and `--backfill --json` are accepted, and the command without `--backfill` is refused. The main fixture test checks the printed report: the count line "queued 6 · re-queued 1 · priority set 0 · skipped 2" and a "why: dormant: the planner stage" line; render() prints a why: line for every cause. I did not run the real backfill in the snapshot, because it would commit records and change git state.

criteria.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks on this tree: fmt passed, clippy with -D warnings passed, and cargo test passed (1414 tests).

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the backfill.
criteria.evidence: The diff adds an "Added" entry for `athena hestia review --backfill`. It covers the dormant skip, the re-queue through the shared builder with the old request closed, new root-cause requests, top-five urgent, the printed report and --json, the idempotent second run, and the status dormant section.

criteria.criterion: Disabled stages are read from athena.toml, not hardcoded. Re-queued and new requests go through the existing shared steward request builder, with no duplicate construction path.
criteria.evidence: `Stage::disabled(&config)` reads `config.job_plan.enabled` from `JobConfig::at(git, head)`, in both error_review_backfill and status. The test `a_stage_is_dormant_only_while_athena_toml_switches_it_off` shows the cause is queued once athena.toml sets enabled = true. New requests use `root_cause_request_at` → `StewardRequest::new`, and the existing `root_cause_request` now delegates to it. Re-queues use `rebuild_request` → `StewardRequest::new(...).render()`. No other code builds request text.

findings.summary: A file outside the expected deliverables changed: crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs
findings.evidence: The diff stat lists display.rs (+55), which is not on the deliverables list. It adds dormant_causes_section and a test. The text `athena status` is rendered there, so the dormant section the request asks for needs this change. The scope list should have included it.

findings.summary: A cause's stage is guessed from words in its text, so a cause that only mentions the planner or critic would be marked dormant
findings.evidence: Stage::of returns the first word in the class name or cause text that is 'planner(s)' or 'critic(s)'. A cause such as 'the producer ignores the planner output' would be marked dormant and never queued. The docs explain this (introspections record no stage), but it is a heuristic.

findings.summary: Matching an existing request without cited ids relies on a substring match of the class name or the normalised cause text
findings.evidence: A steward request the planner refused that paraphrases the cause instead of repeating the class name or cause text is not found. The backfill then queues a second request next to it rather than re-queuing it.

summary: The change does what the request asks, and all seven criteria are met. `athena hestia review --backfill` reads athena.toml at HEAD and skips planner and critic causes while [job_plan] is off. It re-queues an open request that addresses a cause through the shared StewardRequest builder, adding acceptance, files and introspection ids, and closes the old request with a reason. Any other cause gets a new root-cause request through the same builder. Causes are ranked by occurrences, then recency; the top five are urgent and the rest normal. It prints one line per cause with a reason, and `--json` gives the same as data. I ran the targeted tests and they pass: the four-branch fixture test, the second-run test (nothing queued or closed, HEAD unchanged), the status test (each cause shows its request, dormant causes in their own section), the athena.toml enable/disable test, the CLI flag parse test and the dormant display test. I also checked the command's --help. I did not run the real backfill, because it would commit to the snapshot. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed. I found three minor issues and no blockers. display.rs changed but is not on the deliverables list, though the text status lives there so the dormant section needs it. A cause's stage is guessed from words in its text, so a cause that merely mentions the planner could be marked dormant. Matching an existing request that cites no ids depends on it repeating the class name or cause text, so a reworded one could get a duplicate request.
